description: BroadcastChannel and MessageChannel ordering as Node 22 (#215): ports drain in the order they were made, in the poll phase (before immediates, after an already-due timer), one message per task; a port the turn hasn't reached takes a message posted during it; a port with a 'message' listener keeps the program alive. Each case ends once its 60 ms timer has fired and it has all its entries, so a slow host can't end it early, or, after 2 s with no new entry, with what it has, so a lost entry is a diff, not a hang (#696). Needs slicc-kernel 1.92.0's writable BroadcastChannel slot
